```{r}
# Load your metadata file
MEtissue1 <- Read10X_h5("~/Downloads/Alpha_Beta_Paper/GSE203191_RAW/GSM6161374_MEtissue1_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")

metadata <- read.delim("~/Downloads/GSE203191_Shih_endo_meta_frame.tsv") 
samples <- read.csv("~/Downloads/GSE203191_metadata_simple.csv")
metadata <- metadata %>%
  left_join(samples, by = "subjectID")
metadata <- metadata[metadata$run == "MEtissue1", ]

metadata <- metadata[!duplicated(metadata$barcode), ]

rownames(metadata) <- metadata$barcode

common_barcodes_MEtissue1 <- intersect(colnames(MEtissue1), rownames(metadata))

MEtissue1 <- MEtissue1[, common_barcodes_MEtissue1]
metadata_filtered <- metadata[common_barcodes_MEtissue1, ]

all(colnames(MEtissue1) == rownames(metadata_filtered))  # Should be TRUE

MEtissue1 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = MEtissue1, meta.data = metadata_filtered, min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
```

### Merge objects
```{r}
GSE203191_MET <- merge(MEtissue1, y=c(MEtissue2, MEtissue3, MEtissue4, MEtissue5, MEtissue6, MEtissue7), add.cell.ids = c("MEtissue1","MEtissue2","MEtissue3","MEtissue4","MEtissue5","MEtissue6","MEtissue7"))

GSE203191_WME <- merge(wholeME1, y=c(wholeME2, wholeME3), add.cell.ids = c("wholeME1","wholeME2","wholeME3"))

split_MET <- SplitObject(GSE203191_MET, split.by = "pheno")
CMET <- split_MET[["Control"]]  
DMET <- split_MET[["Diagnosed"]]  
SMET <- split_MET[["Symptomatic"]]  

split_WME <- SplitObject(GSE203191_WME, split.by = "pheno")
CWME <- split_WME[["Control"]]  
DWME <- split_WME[["Diagnosed"]]  
SWME <- split_WME[["Symptomatic"]]  

split_MET_patient <- SplitObject(GSE203191_MET, split.by = "library.name")
split_WME_patient <- SplitObject(GSE203191_WME, split.by = "library.name")
```

```{r}
# Get the expression matrix (log-normalized data)
expr_data <- GetAssayData(CPF, slot = "counts")


# Check which cells express ESR1 and/or ESR2
esr1_expr <- expr_data["ESR1", ] > 0
esr2_expr <- expr_data["ESR2", ] > 0

# Boolean logic to define each group
both     <- esr1_expr & esr2_expr
esr1_only <- esr1_expr & !esr2_expr
esr2_only <- !esr1_expr & esr2_expr
neither  <- !esr1_expr & !esr2_expr

# Count cells in each group
counts <- list(
  ESR1_only = sum(esr1_only),
  ESR2_only = sum(esr2_only),
  Both      = sum(both),
  Neither   = sum(neither)
)

print(counts)

```

```{r}
# Boolean logic to define each group
both     <- esr1_expr & esr2_expr
esr1_only <- esr1_expr & !esr2_expr
esr2_only <- !esr1_expr & esr2_expr
neither  <- !esr1_expr & !esr2_expr

# Count cells in each group
counts <- list(
  ESR1_only = sum(esr1_only),
  ESR2_only = sum(esr2_only),
  Both      = sum(both),
  Neither   = sum(neither)
)

print(counts)

```
